hypothesis: March 2026 generated ~₹40k profit (~2.6× best of other months) due to a specific market regime (high IV, strong trend, volatility expansion) that is identifiable in feature space and repeatable.
notes: Forensic analysis of corrected March backtest. Used exp_0002_forensic.py script with same corrected codebase as EXP-0001.

FINDING-1.title: Near-expiry gamma is the entire March edge
FINDING-1.detail: 1-day-before-expiry (Monday) trades: 15 trades → ₹+42,045 (avg ₹2,803/trade). All other 64 March trades combined: ₹-1,578. The entire March outperformance came from cheap near-expiry options bought on MONDAY afternoons that expired in-the-money by TUESDAY. Options bought for ₹5-20 went to ₹70-185.
FINDING-1.actionability: TRADEABLE — can filter specifically for near-expiry setups (days_to_expiry = 1). This is a distinct sub-strategy with very different risk/reward profile.

FINDING-2.title: Daily range is the strongest cross-month predictor
FINDING-2.detail: Avg P&L per trade by daily range across ALL 6 months: <200pts=-₹53, 200-300pts=+₹97, 300-400pts=+₹277, 400-600pts=+₹604, >600pts=-₹264. The sweet spot is 300-600pt daily ranges. March averaged 358 pts. February (-37%) and May (-12%) averaged ~200-250 pts. Extremely high ranges (>600) also underperform — likely too choppy/reversal-prone.
FINDING-2.actionability: HIGHLY ACTIONABLE — filter out trading on days with range < 250 pts. The strategy loses money consistently below this threshold. Implement as daily pre-market check.

FINDING-3.title: STRONG_SINGLE zone type drives profitable trades; CONFLUENCE is a drag
FINDING-3.detail: In March: STRONG_SINGLE 58 trades ₹+43k (74%), CONFLUENCE 18 trades ₹-2k. This is counter-intuitive — normally confluent zones are considered stronger signals. But in high-volatility trending markets, single strong weekly/monthly levels act as true support/resistance while tight multi-level clusters may represent indecision zones that get blown through.
FINDING-3.actionability: MODERATE — needs cross-regime validation before adjusting zone type preference. May be specific to high-volatility trending regimes.

FINDING-4.title: Afternoon and Closing sessions dominate; Morning Open consistently loses in March
FINDING-4.detail: March by session: AFTERNOON ₹+22k (29 trades), CLOSING ₹+12k (9 trades), MID_MORNING ₹+10k (24 trades), MORNING_OPEN ₹-3.5k (17 trades). The 09:15-09:55 session loses money across March. High gap-open days create false breakouts as price reverses back into the previous day's range.
FINDING-4.actionability: MODERATE — skip first 30-45 minutes on high-volatility days, especially gap days.

FINDING-5.title: March had consistently high daily range (avg 358 pts vs 250 for others)
FINDING-5.detail: 5-min ATR: March 37.58 pts vs Feb 26.00, Jun 23.97, Jul 19.58. Daily range: March 362 avg vs 178-290 for other months. This is the regime signal — not a single outlier day but sustained high volatility across the entire month.
FINDING-5.actionability: HIGH — sustained high ATR (>35 on 5-min basis) is the key regime identifier for when this strategy is in its sweet spot.

regime_identified.name: HIGH_VOLATILITY_EXPIRY_GAMMA
conditions: Daily range > 300 pts (measured at session open vs prior-day range avg)
Days to expiry = 1 (Monday for Tuesday-expiry NIFTY)
regime_identified.frequency: ~3-4 qualifying Mondays per month in high-volatility regime

conclusion: HYPOTHESIS PARTIALLY CONFIRMED. March 2026 DID exploit a specific regime, but it was narrower than expected — it was primarily a near-expiry gamma play (1 day before expiry) on high-range days (>300 pts). The 15 Monday afternoon trades generated ₹42k; the remaining 64 trades generated effectively nothing (₹-1.6k). The strategy's broad 'trade every pivot breakout' approach leaves a lot of edge on the table. The primary actionable insight is: FILTER BY DAY RANGE AND NEAR-EXPIRY STATUS.
